name: Archie Dining Table
shortDescription: Archie Black Curved Rectangular Dining Table with Statuario White Sintered Stone Top - 160x90cm Archie dining table with Statuario White sintered stone top and brushed brass edge.
description: Archie Black Curved Rectangular Dining Table with Statuario White Sintered Stone Top - 160x90cm Archie dining table with Statuario White sintered stone top and brushed brass edge. Features a rectangular shape with rounded corners. Measures 160x90cm and seats up to six people. Supported by two matte black ribbed cylindrical legs with brass bases. In the world of modern design, Koala Living introduces the Archie Collection, a manifestation of Emily's innovative vision. Inspired by her global adventures and experiences at the renowned Salone del Mobile Milano fair, Emily was captivated by column sculptures, inspiring her to reimagine them in the realm of furniture. Thus, the Archie Collection was born. At its core, Archie showcases sculptural iron legs cradling a sintered stone tabletop. The stone's captivating hues reflect the beauty of earth's own minerals, each piece a tribute to timeless elegance. This collection comprises two variations of round coffee tables, two dining table options in various sizes, a side table, and a bar table. The dining tables offer two distinct color schemes: a serene white with subtle grey veins for a monochromatic allure, and a lavish black adorned with brushed gold and bronze veins for a more opulent feel. The Archie Collection epitomizes the pinnacle of contemporary furniture craftsmanship. The Archie dining table draws the eye with its White sintered stone top, where soft grey veining flows like brushstrokes across a luminous surface edged in brushed brass. Its rounded-corner form invites easy conversation and an open, welcoming feel. At 160x90cm, it seats up to six, making it ideal for shared meals and gatherings. Two ribbed matte black columns with brass bases ground the piece with a sculptural presence.

price.note: 4-seater dining sets from ₹30,000; solid sheesham 6-seater sets ₹52,000.

The pristine white sintered stone top evokes the sophistication and luxurious finishes reminiscent of the period, providing a gleaming, hardwearing surface that echoes the opulence of marble halls from the Roaring Twenties.
